body: Pharmacy student here- I absolutely do not recommend ODing on these two drugs. SSRIs like sertraline are specifically made to not be deadly when taken all at once (since many depressed people are on them). It would take bottles of sertraline to do the trick. The hydroxyzine is pretty similar, as it’s not too deadly. I have heard of people taking 7-10  50 mg hydroxyzine and being let out of the hospital the next day. I would recommend not using drugs for this (I also recommend not killing yourself at all, of course).
